module: "Doors" marker for the player on foot (building entrances, for example). Same principle as vehicleTrigger: each door is a pair of scene objects (zone, icon); the icon rises when the character enters the zone, an optional 3D screen is displayed for 5 s, and the marker becomes interactive. Unlike vehicleTrigger, the overlap is only tested if the player is walking (data.isWalking) and below the cruising speed. The module returns {create, cluster}.
notes: cluster groups the POIs whose door name pairs (zone name + icon name, sorted) are identical; id 'walkingMarker#<concatenated names>'. Reads poi.markerInfo.walkingMarker.{doors, icon, iconLift, iconOffsetHeight, pos, radius, screens}; default icon poi_exclamationmark_round; elemData groups the poi.data.
The cluster does not fill in pos or radius: only visibilityPos and visibilityRadius are defined, so setup uses the default null position for self.pos (used by the screen's sound).
Icon ids are of the form <cluster.id>-gsIcon-<idx> (prefix reused from the gas station, no functional consequence).
Each door is evaluated separately (overlap per door), unlike vehicleTrigger where the global result is applied to all doors.
drawAxisBox is an unused debug utility.

create.desc: Builds a doors marker for pedestrians (instance of C).

cluster.desc: Groups the walkingMarker POIs with the same door names and adds one cluster per group to allClusters.

allClusters.desc: List of clusters completed in place.

C.desc: Doors marker for the player on foot.

setup.desc: For each door, finds the zone object and the icon object, computes the zone's box, hides the associated screen and creates the icon.

update.desc: Every frame: tests, per door, the OBB/OBB overlap (only if the player is walking and below the cruising speed), handles screens, sound, icons and debug line, then updates isInAreaChanged and anyOverlap.

data.desc: Frame data: isWalking, cruisingSpeedFactor, bbCenter, bbHalfAxis0..2, camPos, bigMapActive, dt.

createObjects.desc: Cleans up existing objects (does not create any).

hide.desc: Becomes invisible, makes the icons transparent and hides the screens.

clearObjects.desc: Removes the icons, hides the screens and clears the door list.

interactInPlayMode.desc: If canInteract and the player is in a door, adds the cluster's data (elemData) to the interactive elements.

drawAxisBox.desc: Draws a debug box (edges and faces) via debugDrawer; not used here.

drawOnMinimap.desc: Draws a circle on the minimap at the position of each door icon.
